title: Exploratory Data Analysis Of Pokemon Data - 2022 Submission for DataDNA Challenge
description:
This is my submission for the 2022 DataDNA challenge hosted by OnyxData — an exploratory data analysis built around a Pokémon dataset, digging into the patterns hidden in the data.

It combines SQL and Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow) for the data work with Power BI for interactive visualisation and reporting.
